items.coder_A: Litenimod (TLR9 agonist) is a pharmacological immune agonist but is given only as the vaccine adjuvant; coded as part of the excluded vaccine intervention, which leaves no candidate.
items.proposed: has_eligible_candidate false; litenimod excluded_intervention_type (part of vaccine); exclusion reason excluded_intervention_type
items.reason: Litenimod is given at a fixed dose "as an adjuvant" to the A52-Mel/A49-Mel peptide vaccines, and the only arm is "A52-Mel; A49-Mel (for Phase1 only) and Litenimod, as an adjuvant". It has no arm or outcome of its own, so under D30-R4 it is part of the excluded vaccine therapy. The agreed coding stands.

note: any_molecular_selection is true because of "Phase 1 only: PTPRZ1 expression in the tumor" (an entry requirement for part of the trial; not candidate-matched because there is no candidate). The trial is excluded at S6 either way. D31-B8 confirms litenimod (vaccine adjuvant) as excluded_intervention_type; the IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma exclusion is exempt under D31-A5. Nothing needs XL.
